open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld]
  case fvar =>
    intros x Hin

    simp_all
  case op =>
    intros x Hin
    simp_all
  case const =>
    intros x Hin
    simp_all
  case bvar =>
    intros x Hin
    simp_all
  case abs ih =>
    exact ih
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case app ih1 ih2 =>
    split
    . split
      . simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      . simp at *
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
    . simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih1 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
        cases Hin <;> simp_all
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply ih2 <;> assumption
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case quant trih eih =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      rename_i m1 k1 ty1 trigger1 e1
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    simp [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] at *
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
      cases Hin <;> simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  -- assume ¬(f = 0)
    rw [funext_iff]
    by_contra h₀
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 h₀

  -- [1] Proof that `f` is continuous at `x₀`.
  -- Embed into the true IP-space `WithLp 2 V`.
    let f₂ : Y → WithLp 2 V := toL2 ℝ ∘ f
    let x₂ := f₂ x₀
  -- x₂ ≠ 0 because `fromL2 (toL2 (f x₀)) = f x₀`
    have hx2 : x₂ ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hx0
      exact congrArg (fromL2 ℝ) h
  -- continuity of f₂ at x₀
    have hcont₂ : ContinuousAt f₂ x₀ := ((toL2 ℝ).continuous.comp hf).continuousAt

  -- [2] find open neighborhood guaranteeing positive inner product with the center, based on
  -- which the test function `g` will be constructed.
  -- pick δ₂ so that on B(x₀, δ₂), ‖f₂ x - x₂‖ < ‖x₂‖/2
    obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂_pos, hδ₂⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont₂ (‖x₂‖ / 2)
      (by simpa using (norm_pos_iff.mpr hx2))
  -- now the usual “add & subtract” proof inside WithLp 2 V
    have inner_pos₂ : ∀ x (hx : x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂), 0 < (⟪f₂ x, x₂⟫_ℝ : ℝ) := by
      intros x hx
    -- hx : x ∈ ball x₀ δ₂, so dist x x₀ < δ₂, hence
    -- this is |⟪u,v⟫| ≤ ‖u‖ * ‖v‖, in the genuine InnerProductSpace on WithLp 2 V
      have hclose : ‖f₂ x - x₂‖ < ‖x₂‖ / 2 := by
        convert hδ₂ hx using 1
        exact mem_sphere_iff_norm.mp rfl
      have hself : ⟪x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ = ‖x₂‖^2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq (x₂ : WithLp 2 V)
      -- Cauchy–Schwarz in `WithLp 2 V` bounds the cross term from below
      have hcs : -(‖f₂ x - x₂‖ * ‖x₂‖) ≤ ⟪f₂ x - x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ :=
        neg_le_of_abs_le $ abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      have hxp : 0 < ‖x₂‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hx2
      have inner_eq_self_add_diff : ⟪f₂ x, x₂⟫_ℝ = ⟪x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ + ⟪f₂ x - x₂, x₂⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [← inner_add_left]
        simp
      nlinarith [inner_eq_self_add_diff, hcs, hself, hclose, hxp,
        mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hclose hxp]
  -- pull `inner_pos₂` back to V via `fromL2`:
    have inner_pos_V : ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := λx hx => inner_pos₂ x hx
    -- now we have a genuine positive integrand on a set of positive measure.

  -- [3] `g` construction using bump function.
    have bump_exists : ∃ φ : Y → ℝ, IsTestFunction φ ∧ φ x₀ > 0 ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Function.support φ, 0 ≤ φ x) ∧
        Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ (δ₂/2) ∧
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.closedBall x₀ $ δ₂/4, 0 < φ x) := by
        -- use `hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace`, leveraging `[innerProductSpace Y]`
          let φ1 : ContDiffBump x₀ :=
            ⟨δ₂ / 4, δ₂ / 2, by positivity, by linarith⟩
          refine ⟨φ1.toFun, ⟨φ1.contDiff, φ1.hasCompactSupport⟩,
            φ1.pos_of_mem_ball $ Metric.mem_ball_self φ1.rOut_pos, λx _ => φ1.nonneg,
            by rw [ContDiffBump.support_eq], λx hx => φ1.pos_of_mem_ball ?_⟩
        -- the closed ball of radius `δ₂/4` lies in the open ball of radius `rOut = δ₂/2`
          exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr $ lt_of_le_of_lt hx $ by show δ₂ / 4 < δ₂ / 2; linarith
    obtain ⟨φ, hφ_testfun, hφ_pos_x₀, hφ_non_neg, hφ_support_subset, hφ_pos_inner⟩ :=
      bump_exists
  -- Define test function g(x) = φ(x) * f(x₀)
    let g : Y → V := λx => φ x • f x₀
  -- Show that g is a test function: `φ` is a test function and `f x₀` is smooth (constant)
    have hg_test : IsTestFunction g := IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ_testfun contDiff_const

  -- [4] Derive contradiction. First compute the integral ∫ ⟪f x, g x⟫
  -- [4.1] ∫ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ = 0
    have key_integral := hg g hg_test
  -- linearity of inner product in the second argument turns the integrand into `φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫`
    simp only [g, inner_smul_right'] at key_integral

  -- [4.2] 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ. Sketch: on the support of φ (which is contained in
  -- B(x₀, δ/2) ⊆ B(x₀, δ)), we have ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ > ‖f x₀‖²/2 > 0 by our choice of δ.
  -- Since φ is nonnegative on its support and positive somewhere, this gives the contradiction.

  -- [4.2.1] Integrability of the integrand: `integrable_prod` .
    have support_subset : Function.support φ ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ₂ :=
      hφ_support_subset.trans $ Metric.ball_subset_ball $ by linarith
    have supp_subset2 : Function.support (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) ⊆ Function.support φ := by
      intro x hprod hφ0
    -- if φ x = 0 then φ x * inner = 0, contradiction
      simp [hφ0] at hprod
    have hinner_cont : Continuous (λx => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
      Continuous.inner' (f : Y → V) (λ_ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
    have integrable_prod :
      Integrable (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) μ :=
    -- (i) build a `HasCompactSupport` witness for the product
      (Continuous.mul hφ_testfun.smooth.continuous hinner_cont).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hφ_testfun.supp.mono supp_subset2)

  -- [4.2.2] Nonnegativity everywhere (`h_nonneg`)
    have h_nonneg : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
      intro x
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
      · -- on the support, φ ≥ 0 and ⟪f x, f x₀⟫ > 0
        exact mul_nonneg (hφ_non_neg x hx) (inner_pos_V x $ support_subset hx).le
      · -- off the support, φ x = 0 so the product is 0
        simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx]

  -- [4.2.3] That closed ball has positive measure, and is contained in the support
    -- every nonempty open set has positive measure
    have hμ_ball : 0 < μ (Metric.ball x₀ $ δ₂/4) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos μ $ Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr $ by linarith
    have hμ : 0 < μ (Metric.closedBall x₀ $ δ₂/4) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hμ_ball $ measure_mono Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
    have closedBall_subset_support :
        Metric.closedBall x₀ (δ₂/4)
          ⊆ Function.support (λx => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := by
        intro x hx
        have hφx := hφ_pos_inner x hx
        have hin : 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
          inner_pos_V x $ Metric.closedBall_subset_ball (by linarith) hx
        simp only [Function.support_mul, Set.mem_inter_iff, Function.mem_support]
        constructor
        · linarith
        · linarith

  -- [4.2.4] putting everything together: positivity contradicts `key_integral : ∫ ... = 0`
    have integral_pos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ :=
      (integral_pos_iff_support_of_nonneg h_nonneg integrable_prod).mpr
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hμ $ measure_mono closedBall_subset_support)
    linarith

open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intros Hnorm
  induction post <;>
    simp only [extractOldExprVars, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.append_assoc] at * <;>
    try simp_all
  case app fn e fn_ih e_ih =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    . simp
      intros x Hin
      exact Hin
    . next Hfalse =>
      cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      exfalso
      specialize Hn ?_
      constructor
      cases Hn
      apply Hfalse
      rfl
    . cases Hnorm with
      | app H1 H2 Hn =>
      apply List.Subset.app
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply fn_ih
        exact H1
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
      . apply List.Subset.trans
        apply e_ih
        exact H2
        intros x Hin
        simp_all
  case abs ih =>
    cases Hnorm
    grind
  case quant trih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply trih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case ite cih tih eih =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply cih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply tih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply eih <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
  case eq ih1 ih2 =>
    cases Hnorm
    apply List.Subset.app
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih1 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all
    . apply List.Subset.trans
      apply ih2 <;> assumption
      intros x Hin
      simp_all

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  refine ⟨(updatedStates σ ks' vs'), ?_⟩
  have Hk : (isDefined σ' ks) := UpdateStatesDefined Hup
  have Hlen1 := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hlen2 := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  induction Hup generalizing σ''
  case update_none =>
    simp_all
    apply And.intro
    refine updatedStatesInit Hlen1 ?_ ?_
    exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
    exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    simp [InitStatesUpdated Hinit]
    constructor
  case update_some σ x v σ₀ xs vs σ₁ Hup Hups ih =>
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    . apply updatedStatesInit Hlen1
      apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
      apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
      exact InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
      exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
    . apply UpdateStates.update_some (σ':=updatedStates σ₀ ks' vs')
      . simp [UpdateStateUpdated Hup, updatedStates]
        rewrite [← updatedStateComm']
        . have Hdef := UpdateStateDefined' Hup
          simp [isDefined, Option.isSome] at Hdef
          split at Hdef <;> simp_all only [List.length_cons, Bool.false_eq_true]
          next val heq =>
          apply updatedStateUpdate (v':=val)
          apply InitStatesSomeMonotone heq
          apply updatedStatesInit
          . simp_all only
          . apply UpdateStateNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hup
            apply UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' ?_ Hups
            apply InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          . exact InitStatesNodup Hinit
        . rewrite [List.unzip_zip] <;> simp_all only [List.length_cons]
          have Hnd := InitStatesNotDefined Hinit
          simp only [isDefined] at *
          intros Hin
          specialize Hnd _ Hin
          simp_all
      . apply (ih Hinit ?_ ?_).2.2
        . simp [isDefined] at * <;> simp_all
        . grind

  case fvar => intro x hx; simp_all
  case abs => assumption
  case app =>
    split
    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars] <;> grind [List.Subset, List.mem_append]

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  have hl := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl hn (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  have hd : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
    have hk := UpdateStatesDefined' hu
    simp only [List.Disjoint, isDefined, isNotDefined] at *
    grind
  have he : σ'' = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
    rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
    exact updatedStatesComm (by simpa [List.unzip_zip, UpdateStatesLength hu, hl] using hd)
  rw [he]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu) (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))

  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    apply (real_inner_self_pos (x := toL2 ℝ (f x₀))).2
    intro h
    exact hx (congrArg (fromL2 ℝ) h)
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have hn : {x | 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ} ∈ nhds x₀ :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc).mem_nhds hp
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hr, he⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset (n := ⊤) hn
  have ht : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f x₀) :=
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ contDiff_const
  have hz := hg _ ht
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  have hnon : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : φ x = 0
    · simp [hx]
    · exact mul_nonneg (hr (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hs (subset_closure hx)).le
  have hpos : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ := by
    apply (hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hk.mul_right hnon
    exact (mul_pos (by simpa [he]) hp).ne'
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hz

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  have hl := InitStatesLength hi
  have hk := UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl hn (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength hu) (updatedStatesDefMonotone hk)
  simp only [List.unzip_zip (UpdateStatesLength hu), List.unzip_zip hl]
  simp only [List.Disjoint, isDefined, isNotDefined] at *
  grind

theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro h
  induction h <;> simp_all [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, extractOldExprVars,
    Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset]
  case app hn he ho ihf ihe =>

    · simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · rename_i hf

theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext x₀
  by_contra hx
  have hp := lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp hx)
  have hc := hf.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x₀) continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hs, hk, hd, hr, he⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hp))
  have hz := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hd, hk⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact ((hd.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
    hk.mul_right (fun x => by
      by_cases hx : φ x = 0
      · simp [hx]
      · exact mul_nonneg (hr (Set.mem_range_self x)).1 (hs (subset_closure hx)).le)
    (mul_pos (he.symm ▸ zero_lt_one) hp).ne').ne' hz

  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu
  have hl := InitStatesLength hi
  have hk := UpdateStatesDefined' hu
  have hu' := UpdateStatesLength hu
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl hn (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  exact updatedStatesUpdate hu' (updatedStatesDefMonotone hk)
  simp_all only [List.unzip_zip]
  intro x hx hx'
  simpa [hn x hx'] using hk x hx

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (λy => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    λj => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] λy => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    λj k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (λs => ∂[j] (λy => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    λj => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (λs => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable $ by simp only [ne_eq, WithTop.coe_eq_zero, ENat.top_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]) x i
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (λt =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (λx => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid $ electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl) _,
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂ₜ (λt => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sub]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum λj _ => hBt j).differentiableAt]
      rw [fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
      simp only [_root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Time.deriv_eq]
      · exact ((Differentiable.fun_sum λj _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      · exact hJt.differentiableAt.const_mul _
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ((∑ j, ∂ₜ λt => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c t · (j, i)) x) t) -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * (∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t) := by
      congr
      rw [Time.deriv_eq]
      rw [fderiv_fun_sum λi _ => (hBt i).differentiableAt]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∑ j, ∂[j] λx => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · x (j, i)) t) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      congr
      simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
      congr
      funext k
      rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv]
      apply magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff
      apply hA.of_le $ right_eq_inf.mp rfl
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *(∑ j, ∂[j] λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x -
        ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext k
        congr
        funext x
        rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ $ hA.of_le $ ENat.LEInfty.out]
    _ = (1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x -
          ∂[j] (λx => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x)) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        simp only [Finset.sum_apply]
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
        simp only [_root_.sub_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by simp only [mul_inv_rev, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, mul_sub]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
        1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[i] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        funext j
        rw [Space.deriv_commute _ $ hEs _, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (λx => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr
        rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        rw [fderiv_fun_sum]
        simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
        intro j _
        exact (hEd j j).differentiableAt
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (λx => ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) x) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * (∂[i] (λx => (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) x) x) -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        rfl
      _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
          1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀ ^ 2) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
          1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
        congr 2
        rw [isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix] at h

        conv_lhs =>
          enter [2, 2, x]
          rw [(h t x).1]
        trans 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * Space.deriv i
            (λx => (1/ 𝓕.ε₀) * LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity 𝓕.c J t x) x
        · congr
          funext x
          ring
        · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
          rw [fderiv_const_mul]
          simp only [_root_.smul_apply, ← deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, smul_eq_mul]
          field_simp
          apply Differentiable.differentiableAt
          apply LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          exact hJ.differentiable $ by simp only [ne_eq, WithTop.coe_eq_zero, ENat.top_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true]
        · exact hA
        · exact hJ
      _ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
            𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
          simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq]
          field_simp

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b $ Basis.mem_span _ b
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a $ Basis.mem_span _ a
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      dsimp only [pa]
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofList_singleton, mul_sub, ← ofCrAnListF_append, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul, List.append_assoc, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs)) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF $ crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF $ List.takeWhile (λc => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF $ List.filter (λc =>

                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs)) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF $ List.takeWhile (λc => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs)) *

                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs)))) := by

          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append], h1]

          simp only [ofCrAnListF_append]

        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF $ List.takeWhile (λc => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel $ φs' ++ φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF $ List.filter (λc => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs') *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *

              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp $ ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ]
      simp only [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,

      simp only [decide_not, Bool.decide_and, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' : Typing Γ t τ := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            have ⟨σ, t₁, eq⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs val_l
            refine ⟨t₁ ^ᵗᵗ t₂, ?_⟩
            grind
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', _⟩ := red_r
            refine ⟨t₁.app t₂', ?_⟩
            grind
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red_l
        refine ⟨t₁'.app t₂, ?_⟩
        grind
  case tapp σ' der _ ih =>
    right
    specialize ih rfl der
    cases ih with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t, _⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
        exists t ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        refine ⟨.tapp t' σ', ?_⟩
        grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        refine ⟨t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, ?_⟩
        grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        refine ⟨t₁'.let' t₂, ?_⟩
        grind
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        refine ⟨.inl t', ?_⟩
        grind
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases (ih rfl der) with
    | inl val => grind
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', _⟩ := red
        refine ⟨.inr t', ?_⟩
        grind
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        have ⟨t₁, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
        cases lr <;> [exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁; refine ⟨t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁, ?_⟩] <;> grind
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', _⟩ := red
        refine ⟨t₁'.case t₂ t₃, ?_⟩
        grind
  case sub => grind
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.abs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind
  case tabs L _ _=>
    left
    constructor
    apply LC.tabs L
    · grind only [→ wf, cases Term.LC]
    · grind

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  case refl => exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  case par a a' b b' ha' hb' =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      refine ⟨a' ⬝ b', ?_⟩
      exact ⟨.refl $ a' ⬝ b', .par ha' hb'⟩
    case par a'' b'' ha'' hb'' =>
      let ⟨a₃, ha⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha' ha''
      let ⟨b₃, hb⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb' hb''
      refine ⟨a₃ ⬝ b₃, ?_⟩
      constructor
      · exact .par ha.1 hb.1
      · exact .par ha.2 hb.2
    case red_I =>
      rewrite [I_irreducible a' ha']
      use b', .red_I b'
    case red_K =>
      let ⟨a₂', ha₂'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ a' ha'
      rewrite [ha₂'.2]
      refine ⟨a₂', ?_⟩
      exact ⟨.red_K a₂' b', ha₂'.1⟩
    case red_S a c =>
      let ⟨a'', c', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c a' ha'
      rewrite [h.2.2]
      refine ⟨a'' ⬝ b' ⬝ (c' ⬝ b'), .red_S a'' c' b', ?_⟩
      apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        apply ParallelReduction.par <;>
        grind
  case red_I =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => refine ⟨a₁, ?_⟩; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_I a₁⟩
    case par c a₁' hc ha =>
      rewrite [I_irreducible c hc]
      refine ⟨a₁', ?_⟩
      exact ⟨ha, .red_I a₁'⟩
    case red_I => refine ⟨a₁, ?_⟩; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_K c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => refine ⟨a₁, ?_⟩; exact ⟨.refl a₁, .red_K a₁ c⟩
    case par a' c' ha hc =>
      let ⟨a₁', h'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₁ a' ha
      rewrite [h'.2]
      refine ⟨a₁', ?_⟩
      exact ⟨h'.1, .red_K a₁' c'⟩
    case red_K =>
      refine ⟨a₁, ?_⟩
      exact ⟨.refl a₁, .refl a₁⟩
  case red_S a b c =>
    cases h₂
    case refl =>
      refine ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), ?_⟩
      exact ⟨.refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    case par d c' hd hc =>
      let ⟨a', b', h⟩ := Sab_irreducible a b d hd
      rewrite [h.2.2]
      refine ⟨a' ⬝ c' ⬝ (b' ⬝ c'), ?_⟩
      constructor
      · apply ParallelReduction.par
        · exact .par h.left hc
        · exact .par h.2.1 hc
      · exact .red_S ..
    case red_S => exact ⟨a ⬝ c ⬝ (b ⬝ c), .refl _, .refl _,⟩

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    intro j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have gauss : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
        fun y => 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y := by
      funext y
      exact ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1.trans
        (by ring)
    trans ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum
        (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
      simp [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    · rw [gauss, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
      simp [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  have he : (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  rw [he, Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  simp [FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b $ Basis.mem_span _ b
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a $ Basis.mem_span _ a
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      dsimp only [pa]
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
      let X := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
      let Y := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs)) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))
      have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
          (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
          X * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * Y := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, mul_assoc]
      have pair : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) =
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, map_sub, map_smul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
      calc
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (X * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * Y) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
            simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
              map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
              List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          have s1 := split [φ, ψ] (by simp_all)
          have s2 := split [ψ, φ] (by simp_all)
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at s1 s2
          simp only [map_smul]
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2, ← pair]
          simp only [map_smul, mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
          module
        _ = _ := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          have hsort := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
          have hXY : X * Y = ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs))) := by
            conv_rhs => rw [crAnTimeOrderList, hsort]
            simp only [X, Y, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
          rw [mul_assoc, hXY]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero, map_mul]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add, pa]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, implies_true, pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all only [map_mul, mul_add, map_add, pb]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, implies_true, pb]

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -

    intro j

    · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum

    · rw [gauss, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]

      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -

    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | @par a a' b b' ha hb iha ihb =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
    | par ha' hb' =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
      exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
    | red_I =>
      rw [I_irreducible a' ha]
      exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
    | red_K =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_K _ _, hx⟩
    | red_S a c =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible a c _ ha
      exact ⟨_, .red_S _ _ _, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  | red_I =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    | red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hc ha =>
      rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
      exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  | red_K =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    | red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par ha hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
      exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K _ _⟩
  | red_S =>
    cases h₂ with
    | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    | red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    | par hd hc =>
      obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hd
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let pb (b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : b ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
    Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b))
  change pb b $ Basis.mem_span _ b
  apply Submodule.span_induction
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (a : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) (hc : a ∈ Submodule.span ℂ (Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)) :
      Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF φs) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a* ofCrAnListF φs))
    change pa a $ Basis.mem_span _ a
    apply Submodule.span_induction
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [pa, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
      let X := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs'))
      let Y := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs)) *
        ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))
      have split (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
          (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
          X * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * Y := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ _ _ _ _ hl]
        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, mul_assoc]
      have pair : ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) • ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) =
          ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF := by
        rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, map_sub, map_smul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
      calc
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (X * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * Y) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
            simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
              map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
              List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          have s1 := split [φ, ψ] (by simp_all)
          have s2 := split [ψ, φ] (by simp_all)
          simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at s1 s2
          simp only [map_smul]
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2, ← pair]
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
          module
        _ = _ := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          have hsort := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
          have hXY : X * Y = ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φs))) := by
            conv_rhs => rw [crAnTimeOrderList, hsort]
            simp only [X, Y, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
          rw [mul_assoc, hXY]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero, map_mul]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by simp_all),
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp only [map_mul, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    · simp only [map_mul, zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero, pa]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add, pa]
    · intro x hx hpx
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, implies_true, pa]
  · simp only [map_mul, mul_zero, map_zero, pb]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp_all only [map_mul, mul_add, map_add, pb]
  · intro x hx hpx
    simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, implies_true, pb]

  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by

    trans ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum
        (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    · rw [gauss, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  have he : (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)

  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)

    ← Time.deriv_eq]

        simp only [ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, X, Y, mul_assoc]

          ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, map_sub, map_smul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
      calc
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
            (X * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * Y) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF]
            simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
              map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_append,

            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]

    · simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add] at *

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    intro j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have gauss : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
        fun y => 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y := by
      funext y
      exact ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1.trans
        (by ring)
    trans ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum
        (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    · rw [gauss, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  have he : (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) = fun s =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  rw [he, Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  generalize (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) = a
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp

          simp only [map_smul]
          rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ, s1, s2, ← pair]
          simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc]
          module
        _ = _ := by
          rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
          have hXY := split [] (by simp)
          simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at hXY
          rw [mul_assoc, ← hXY]
          by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
          · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero, map_mul]
          · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_not.mp hq).symm,
              ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]

    · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
      simp only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add] at hpx hpy ⊢
      rw [hpx, hpy]
    · intro r x hx hpx
      simp only [map_mul, smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, mul_smul_comm]
      rw [hpx, map_mul]
  · simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  · intro x y hx hy hpx hpy
    simp only [map_mul, mul_add, map_add] at hpx hpy ⊢
    rw [hpx, hpy]
  · intro r x hx hpx
    simp only [map_mul, mul_smul_comm, map_smul]
    rw [hpx, map_mul]

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.red_I | red_K.red_K | red_S.red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
  case red_I.refl | red_K.refl | red_S.refl | par.refl =>
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption
  case par.par iha ihb a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case par.red_I hb ihb ha iha =>
    rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K ha ih =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩

    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    first
    | exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
    | exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb), .red_S ..⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha =>
    rw [I_irreducible _ hc]
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var => grind
  case abs => exact Or.inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub => grind
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with vl | ⟨t', red⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with vr | ⟨t', red⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl red⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red⟩
  case tapp σ' der sub ih =>
    right
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs val
      refine ⟨_, .tabs val.lc ?_⟩
      grind
    · refine ⟨_, .tapp ?_ red⟩
      grind
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    have body := (body_let.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body val body⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind red body⟩
  case inl der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact Or.inl (.inl val)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, .inl red⟩
  case inr der _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · exact Or.inl (.inr val)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨_, .inr red⟩
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have bodies := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      rcases lr with rfl | rfl
      · refine ⟨_, .case_inl ?_ bodies.1 bodies.2⟩
        cases val; assumption
      · refine ⟨_, .case_inr ?_ bodies.1 bodies.2⟩
        cases val; assumption
    · exact ⟨_, .case red bodies.1 bodies.2⟩

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hb : ∀ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    intro j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl))]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg : (∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x) =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have gauss : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
        fun y => 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y := by
      funext y
      exact ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1.trans
        (by ring)
    trans ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
    · rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum
        (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
      simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    · rw [gauss, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_const_mul
        (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
          (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
      (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt]
  simp only [FunLike.coe_sub, Pi.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq]
  rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum _ _ (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
  simp only [hb, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  generalize (∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) = a
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq]
  field_simp

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs
  constructor
  · constructor
    assumption
  intro s1 s2 r μ
  constructor
  case left =>
    intro s1' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
        refine ⟨s2', ?_⟩
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr2
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        refine ⟨s1', ?_⟩
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s2', htr2, hr2⟩ := hb.follow_fst hr htr
      refine ⟨s2', ?_⟩
      constructor
      · assumption
      constructor
      apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr2
  case right =>
    intro s2' htr
    cases r
    case choice p q r hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      cases htr
      case choiceL a b c htr =>
        obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
        refine ⟨s1', ?_⟩
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceL htr1
        · constructor
          apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1
      case choiceR a b c htr =>
        refine ⟨s2', ?_⟩
        constructor
        · apply Tr.choiceR htr
        · constructor
          apply HomBisimilarity.refl
    case bisim hbisim =>
      obtain ⟨rel, hr, hb⟩ := hbisim
      obtain ⟨s1', htr1, hr1⟩ := hb.follow_snd hr htr
      refine ⟨s1', ?_⟩
      constructor
      · assumption
      · constructor
        apply hb.le_bisimilarity _ _ hr1

      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _), time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (c := 𝓕.c) _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)

    fderiv_fun_sub ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt

theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case red_I.red_I | red_K.red_K | red_S.red_S | red_I.refl | red_K.refl | red_S.refl | par.refl =>
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption
  case par.par iha ihb a'' b'' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case par.red_I hb ihb ha iha | red_I.par ha hb =>
    rw [I_irreducible _ ha]
    exact ⟨_, hb, .red_I _⟩
  case par.red_K ha ih | red_K.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case par.red_S hb ihb a c ha iha | red_S.par ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb), .red_S ..⟩

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    constructor
    · intro s ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
        exact ⟨t, .choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s, .choiceR ht, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
    · intro s ht
      cases ht with
      | choiceL ht =>
        obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
        exact ⟨t, .choiceL ht, .bisim hb⟩
      | choiceR ht => exact ⟨s, .choiceR ht, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    constructor
    · intro s ht
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_fst ht
      exact ⟨t, ht, .bisim hb⟩
    · intro s ht
      obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨t, ht, .bisim hb⟩

lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have der' := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  all_goals have lc := der'.wf.2.1
  case var => grind
  case abs => exact Or.inl (.abs lc)
  case tabs => exact Or.inl (.tabs lc)
  case sub => grind
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l with vl | ⟨t', red⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r with vr | ⟨t', red⟩
      · obtain ⟨σ, b, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs vl
        exact ⟨_, .abs vl.lc vr⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ vl red⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    have ht := ih rfl der
    cases lc
    grind only [→ canonical_form_tabs, → Red.tapp, → Red.tabs, → Value.lc]
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    have ht := ih rfl der
    have body := (body_let.mp lc).2
    grind only [→ Red.let_bind, → Red.let_body]
  case inl der _ ih =>
    have ht := ih rfl der
    grind only [→ Red.inl, → Value.inl]
  case inr der _ ih =>
    have ht := ih rfl der
    grind only [→ Red.inr, → Value.inr]
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    have bodies := (body_case.mp lc).2
    rcases ih rfl der with val | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, lr⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum val
      rcases lr with rfl | rfl <;> cases val <;>
        exact ⟨_, by solve_by_elim [Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr, bodies.1, bodies.2]⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case red bodies.1 bodies.2⟩

  cases hr with

      exact ⟨t, ht, .bisim hb⟩

theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  -- 2 * Δ₀(f, ↑(BBF_Code 𝔽q β ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)) < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 $ ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩

  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp [d_i, BBF_CodeDistance] -- ⊢ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - ↑i) - 2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i) + 1 > 0
    have h_exp_lt : ℓ - i.val < ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val := by
      exact Nat.sub_lt_sub_right (a := ℓ) (b := ℓ + 𝓡) (c := i.val) (by omega) $ by
        apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right
        exact pos_of_neZero 𝓡
    have h_pow_lt : 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) < 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) := by
      exact Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by norm_num) h_exp_lt
    omega

  have h_C_i_nonempty : Nonempty C_i := by
    simp only [nonempty_subtype]
    exact Submodule.nonempty $ BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩

  -- 1. Relate Hamming distance `d_H` to fiber-wise distance `d_fw`.
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    -- Let `S` be the set of all possible fiber-wise disagreement sizes.
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    -- The code `C_i` (a submodule) is non-empty, so `S` is also non-empty.
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := by
      refine Set.image_nonempty.mpr ?_

      exact Set.univ_nonempty
    -- For a non-empty set of natural numbers, `sInf` is an element of the set.
    have h_sInf_mem : sInf S ∈ S := Nat.sInf_mem hS_nonempty
    -- By definition, `d_fw = sInf S`.
    -- Since `sInf S` is in the image set `S`, there must be an element `g_subtype` in the domain
    -- (`C_i`) that maps to it. This `g_subtype` is the codeword we're looking for.
    rewrite [Set.mem_image] at h_sInf_mem
    rcases h_sInf_mem with ⟨g_subtype, _, h_eq⟩
    -- Extract the codeword and its membership proof.
    exact ⟨g_subtype.val, g_subtype.property, by exact id $ Eq.symm h_eq⟩

  -- The Hamming distance to any codeword `g'` is bounded by `d_fw * 2 ^ steps`.
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    -- This proves `dist f g' ≤ (fiberwiseDisagreementSet ... f g').ncard * 2 ^ steps`
    -- and lifts to ℕ∞. We prove the `Nat` version `hammingDist f g' ≤ ...`,
    -- which is equivalent.
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rewrite [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    -- Let ΔH be the finset of actually bad x points where f and g' disagree.
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (λx => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    have h_dist_eq_card : hammingDist f g' = ΔH.card := by
      dsimp only [hammingDist, ΔH]
    rewrite [h_dist_eq_card]
    -- Y_bad is the set of quotient points y that THERE EXISTS a bad fiber point x
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at * -- simplify domain indices everywhere

    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps

    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    -- Every point of disagreement `x` must belong to a fiber over some `y` in `Y_bad`,
    -- BY DEFINITION of `Y_bad`. Therefore, `ΔH` is a subset of the union of the fibers
    -- of `Y_bad`
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := λy => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset $ Fin $ (2:ℕ)^steps)).toFinset) := by
      -- ⊢ If any x ∈ ΔH, then x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      intro x hx_in_ΔH
      -- ⊢ x ∈ Union(qMap_total_fiber(y), ∀ y ∈ Y_bad)
      simp only [ΔH, Finset.mem_filter] at hx_in_ΔH
      -- Now we actually apply iterated qMap into x to get y_of_x,
      -- then x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x) by definition
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr
      refine ⟨y_of_x, ?_⟩
      -- ⊢ y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset ∧ x ∈ qMap_total_fiber(y_of_x)
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset := by
        -- ⊢ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset
        simp only [fiberwiseDisagreementSet, iteratedQuotientMap, ne_eq, Subtype.exists,
          Set.toFinset_setOf, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and, Y_bad]
        -- one bad fiber point of y_of_x is x itself
        let X := x.val
        have h_X_in_source : X ∈ sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem x
        use X
        use h_X_in_source
        -- ⊢ Ŵ_steps⁽ⁱ⁾(X) = y (iterated quotient map) ∧ ¬f ⟨X, ⋯⟩ = g' ⟨X, ⋯⟩
        have h_forward_iterated_qmap : Polynomial.eval X
            (intermediateNormVpoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨↑i, by omega⟩
              ⟨steps, by simp only; omega⟩) = y_of_x := by
          dsimp only [iteratedQuotientMap, y_of_x];
        have h_eval_diff : f ⟨X, by omega⟩ ≠ g' ⟨X, by omega⟩ := by
          unfold X
          simp only [ne_eq, hx_in_ΔH, not_false_eq_true]
        simp only [h_forward_iterated_qmap, h_eval_diff,
          not_false_eq_true, and_self]
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad]

      set qMapFiber := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y_of_x)
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      have h_res := is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp $ by rfl
      exact h_res
    -- ⊢ #ΔH ≤ Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    -- The cardinality of a subset is at most the cardinality of the superset.
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    -- The cardinality of a disjoint union is the sum of cardinalities.
    rewrite [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · -- The size of the sum is the number of bad fibers (`Y_bad.ncard`) times
      -- the size of each fiber (`2 ^ steps`).
      simp only [Set.toFinset_card]
      have h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point := card_qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
        (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i steps h_i_add_steps
      simp only [Set.image_univ,
        Subtype.forall] at h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point
      have h_card_fiber_of_each_y : ∀ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset,
          Fintype.card ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
            ↑(Finset.univ : Finset $ Fin $ (2:ℕ)^steps)) = 2 ^ steps := by
        intro y hy_in_Y_bad
        have hy_card_fiber_of_y := h_card_fiber_per_quotient_point (a := y) (b := by
          exact Submodule.coe_mem y)
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Fintype.card_ofFinset, hy_card_fiber_of_y]
      rewrite [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_card_fiber_of_each_y]
      -- ⊢ ∑ x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps ≤ Y_bad.encard.toNat * 2 ^ steps
      simp only [sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ge_iff_le]
      conv_rhs => rw [←_root_.Nat.card_coe_set_eq] -- convert .ncard back to .card
      -- ⊢ Fintype.card ↑Y_bad ≤ Nat.card ↑Y_bad
      simp only [card_eq_fintype_card, le_refl]
    · -- Prove that the fibers for distinct quotient points y₁, y₂ are disjoint.
      intro y₁ hy₁ y₂ hy₂ hy_ne
      have h_disjoint := qMap_total_fiber_disjoint (i := ⟨↑i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (y₁ := y₁) (y₂ := y₂) (hy_ne := hy_ne)
      simp only [Function.onFun, coe_univ]
      exact h_disjoint

  -- The minimum distance `d_H` is bounded by the distance to this specific `g'`.
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    -- exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
    apply le_trans (a := d_H) (c := d_fw * 2 ^ steps) (b := hammingDist f g')
    · -- ⊢ d_H ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      simp only [distFromCode, SetLike.mem_coe, hammingDist, ne_eq, d_H];
      -- ⊢ Δ₀(f, C_i) ≤ ↑Δ₀(f, g')
      -- ⊢ sInf {d | ∃ v ∈ C_i, ↑(#{i | f i ≠ v i}) ≤ d} ≤ ↑(#{i | f i ≠ g' i})
      apply sInf_le
      use g'
    · exact h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size

  -- 2. Use the premise : `2 * d_fw < d_{i+steps}`.
  -- As a `Nat` inequality, this is equivalent to `2 * d_fw ≤ d_{i+steps} - 1`.
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    -- Convert the ENat inequality to a Nat inequality using `a < b ↔ a + 1 ≤ b`.
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ $ WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt

  -- 3. The Algebraic Identity.
  -- The core of the proof is the identity : `(d_{i+steps} - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1`.
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp [d_i, d_i_plus_steps, BBF_CodeDistance]
    rewrite [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    have h1 : ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    have h2 : (ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps) = ℓ - i := by
      rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev (h1 := by omega) (h2 := by omega),
        Nat.add_sub_cancel (n := i) (m := steps)]
    rw [h1, h2]

  -- 4. Conclusion : Chain the inequalities to prove `2 * d_H < d_i`.
  -- We know `d_H` is finite, since `C_i` is nonempty.
  have h_dH_ne_top : d_H ≠ ⊤ := by
    simp only [ne_eq, d_H]
    rewrite [Code.distFromCode_eq_top_iff_empty f C_i]
    exact Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty'.mp h_C_i_nonempty

  -- We can now work with the `Nat` value of `d_H`.
  let d_H_nat := ENat.toNat d_H
  have h_dH_eq : d_H = d_H_nat := (ENat.coe_toNat h_dH_ne_top).symm

  -- The calculation is now done entirely in `Nat`.
  have h_final_inequality : 2 * d_H_nat ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    have h_bridge_nat : d_H_nat ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
        rewrite [←ENat.coe_le_coe]
        exact le_of_eq_of_le (id $ Eq.symm h_dH_eq) h_dist_bridge
    calc 2 * d_H_nat
      _ ≤ 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by gcongr
      _ = (2 * d_fw) * 2 ^ steps := by rw [mul_assoc]
      _ ≤ (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps := by gcongr;
      _ = d_i - 1 := h_algebraic_identity

  simp only [d_H, d_H_nat] at h_dH_eq
  -- This final line is equivalent to the goal statement.
  rewrite [h_dH_eq]
  -- ⊢ 2 * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, ⋯⟩)
  change ((2 : ℕ) : ℕ∞) * ↑Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat < ↑(BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨↑i, by omega⟩)
  rewrite [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_lt_coe]
  apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred (n := 2 * Δ₀(f, C_i).toNat) (m := d_i) (h := h_d_i_gt_0)
    (h_final_inequality)

theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s1 s2 hr μ
  cases hr <;> rename_i h
  all_goals constructor <;> intro s ht
  case' choice.left | choice.right => cases ht <;> rename_i ht
  case choice.left.choiceR | choice.right.choiceR =>
    exact ⟨s, .choiceR ht, .bisim (.refl s)⟩
  all_goals
    first | apply h.follow_fst at ht | apply h.follow_snd at ht
    obtain ⟨t, ht, hb⟩ := ht
    refine ⟨t, ?_, .bisim hb⟩
    first | exact ht | exact Tr.choiceL ht

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  simp only
  intro y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
